secondBrowserFailure.diagnosis: The native focus movement in PrecisionRange may scroll the overflow:hidden workspace body into the 5px overflow introduced by the east resize edge at right:-5px. Chromium 158 CI proves the horizontal shift after numeric editing; Chromium 156 CUA confirms the 325px scroll extent but does not reproduce the horizontal shift. The fix prevents incidental scrolling on the four explicit focus transfers inside this same control.
